## Test-first checklist

- [ ] Unit tests cover the new logic
- [ ] Integration tests cover behavior across boundaries (where applicable)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
